# Release `v2.3.0`

`v2.3.0` adds the official Fastify adapter and promotes isolated authentication instances as the recommended integration boundary for multi-instance applications.

## Highlights

- Add `@xlt-token/fastify` with `xltFastifyPlugin`, route policies, `config.xlt`, request auth state, and optional centralized error handling.
- Add `createXltInstance()`, `setDefaultXltInstance()`, and `getDefaultXltInstance()` to make explicit instance ownership available outside NestJS.
- Add refresh-token lifecycle rotation, family state, replay detection, and family revocation.
- Update AI-facing documentation, Skill references, and the MCP implementation contract for the current package layout.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add xlt-token@2.3.0

# Fastify applications
pnpm add fastify @xlt-token/fastify
```

## Upgrade Notes

Existing NestJS and Express applications remain compatible. Use `createXltInstance()` and retain the instance handle when the process hosts more than one auth domain. Read the [migration and adapter contract](https://xiaolangtou.github.io/xlt-token/guide/multi-instance-contract) before migrating a multi-instance application.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xiaoLangtou/xlt-token/compare/v2.2.0...v2.3.0
